description: 4-atom bcc-Li POSCAR lowered through the YAML input frontend (vespaw.yaml_input.prepare_run), CG + Anderson run to convergence (EDIFF) -- checks the whole YAML-to-.cntl/.strc-to-binary-to-Result pipeline end to end. Converged value (2026-09-23), cross-checked against MIXER='VARIATIONAL' to <1 uHa; tolerance 1e-5 because a converged energy is only defined to ~EDIFF, while the old 10-iteration value depended on every detail of the mixer trajectory. -- re-referenced 2026-09-29 after the default relativistic treatment changed from ZORA to energy-dependent scalar-relativistic (cross-optimizer agreement and finite-difference checks unchanged) -- re-referenced 2026-10-02 for the corrected PBE reduced gradient (TFAC ported from CP-PAW 2024; also fixed in the SCAN correlation code; TYPE=-10 reproduces the old values)
